content.title: Pershing Square USA starts marketing IPO in combined offering (PSUS:NYSE) | Seeking Alpha
content.text: Skip to contentHome page Seeking Alpha - Power to InvestorsCopy LinkSavePlay(1min)CommentsFollow us on Google for the latest stock newsFollow Seeking Alpha on Google for the latest stock newsBryan Bedder/Getty Images EntertainmentBill Ackman's Pershing Square Capital Management launched the initial public offerings of Pershing Square USA (PSUS) and Pershing Square Inc. on Monday, seeking proceeds from the combined IPO and private offerings of at least $5B. Shares of Pershing Square USA (PSUS) priced at $50 per share, the company said. To each investor participating in the IPO, the company will issue one share of its manager, Pershing Square Inc. (PS) for every five common shares of PSUS acquired at no extra charge. As part of the combined offerings, the investment firm has received commitments from a group of qualified investors to acquire 56.3M common shares of PSUS for proceeds of $2.8B in a private placement. That includes a $100M common shares investment made by Pershing Square and its affiliates. As a result, PS Inc. will deliver to the private placement investors (excluding its affiliates), for no additional consideration, an aggregate of 16.3M shares of PS Inc. common stock, the company said.
